Hannah (sales): Heads-up: Meridian is asking for a POC to replace CompetitorX's /v1/generate. Main asks: exact prompt behavior, token billing comparison, SAML + BYOK. Can we scope minimal POC gates?
Leo (solutions): Quick list: 1) API envelope shim, 2) canonical prompt parity set, 3) token accounting + billing delta, 4) security & legal signoffs, 5) fallback model plan.
Aria (presales): I'll assemble 9 prompts (summary, extraction, rewrite, edge unicode). We'll run A/B and produce per-prompt diffs + human pass rate.
Sam (ML Eng): FYI CompetitorX tokenizes curly quotes and some emojis differently. Expect a small token delta; will add a "compat_tokenize" pre-step. Also will expose a "mirror_mode" variant to tweak repetition_penalty.
Ivy (Security): For POC they accept platform KMS. Production requires BYOK. Need SAML metadata, IP allowlist, retention <=30d. Legal wants DPA before sharing raw prompts.
Hannah (sales): Meridian asked for a sample response envelope match for drop-in testing.
Leo (solutions): We can provide a lightweight adapter. Example mapping: // competitor: {"id":"x","text":"...","usage":{"tokens":90}} -> // shim: {"request_id":"x","choices":[{"text":"..."}],"usage":{"total_tokens":90}}
Aria (presales): Acceptance draft: mean token delta <=11%, human-pass semantic parity >=90%, latency <=1.5x competitor in us-west, no PII in outputs.
Sam (ML Eng): I'll prepare variants: quant-default, fp16, mirror_mode. Will record seed and commit hash.
provision-bot: staging cluster created: meridian-poc (egress IPs: 18.198.12.100, 18.198.12.101)
Ivy (Security): I'll draft security questionnaire answers (KMS integration steps, audit log format, retention policy) and confirm on-prem option.
Hannah (sales): Scheduling kickoff Wed 2pm PT. Action: @Aria test harness, @Leo pricing ramp, @Sam model variants, @Ivy security Q. Ping me if blocked.
